summary: Mendix is low-code application development platform, founded in 2005. Type: private company. About 936 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 91% of its 11 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about acquisitions.

insights.one_liner: Rotterdam-rooted low-code and AI app platform owned by Siemens; mostly English software jobs with pay shown, but not an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: About 936 people on LinkedIn, often from RSM, TU Delft, Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences, Erasmus and Utrecht.
Describes its team as driven and smart, in a diverse, open and safe environment.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: Founded in 2005 and now a Siemens business, with HQ listed in Boston.

worth_knowing.text: The Dutch tax authority lost a multi-million case against Mendix's founders over their share gains.
